adaptation: State changes commit immediately; animation only presents the committed result and must cancel on the next intent.
Preserve the existing component identity, focus and native scroll rather than rebuilding a page to animate it.
Pointer pan uses the fixed initial scroll offset plus the current pointer delta; touch remains native.
notCopied: Upstream theme CSS, desktop-extracted code, fonts, imagery and spring constants.
The upstream globally shared segmented layoutId, which can connect unrelated instances.
The upstream accumulated drag offset and global view-transition hook, which do not meet mooncci rapid-intent and image-stability requirements.
Blurred per-character text reveal, all-page entrance, scroll interception and a second component system.
implementation: Independent mooncci implementations reuse Radix ownership, existing feedbackMotion (motion/mini), motion.css, RoutePosition, native pointer capture and native scrolling. No npm dependency was added.
